title: PowerAtlas: Feasibility-Aware Language Models for Electricity-Computing Co-Scheduling
abstract: arXiv:2607.26710v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Electricity-computing co-scheduling (ECCS) decides where and when computing tasks run together with how generators are dispatched, because task placement changes nodal demand while power availability determines whether tasks can be served. Prior work addresses such coupled problems with optimization or learned controllers, and large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate structured decisions for scheduling and power systems. Solver runtimes vary across instances, and LLM outputs that parse correctly can still violate grid and service constraints. We formalize ECCS as a structured decision task and release ECBench, 2,000 instances with Gurobi-optimal reference schedules and executable checks for grid limits, task service, cost, and latency. translated_title: PowerAtlas：面向电力-计算协同调度的可行性感知语言模型
translated_abstract: 电力-计算协同调度（ECCS）决定计算任务在何处、何时运行，以及发电机如何调度，因为任务的部署位置会改变节点的电力需求，而电力可用性则决定了任务能否得到服务。先前的工作通过优化方法或学习型控制器来解决这类耦合问题，而大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被用于为调度和电力系统生成结构化决策。然而，求解器的运行时间在不同实例之间差异很大，且即使LLM的输出可以被正确解析，仍可能违反电网和服务约束。我们将ECCS形式化为一个结构化决策任务，并发布了ECBench——一个包含2,000个实例的基准数据集，其中附带Gurobi最优参考调度方案，以及针对电网限制、任务服务、成本和延迟的可执行检查。我们提出PowerAtlas，该方法通过监督初始化以及基于确定性评分器反馈的可行性感知GRPO来训练LLM，并能在单次……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将电力-计算协同调度形式化为结构化决策任务，发布了带可执行约束检查的ECBench基准，并提出通过可行性感知GRPO训练的PowerAtlas，使语言模型能生成满足电网与服务约束的联合调度方案。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes electricity-computing co-scheduling as a structured decision task, releases ECBench with executable constraint checks, and proposes PowerAtlas—an LLM trained with Feasibility-Aware GRPO—that generates joint schedules satisfying grid and service constraints.
